title: E3 analysis: co-residency decomposition under the pre-registered rules

statement.criteria: Output of analysis/e3_report.py over campaign 20260927T163134Z-ec7ccc, pinned --until 2026-09-27T23:52:00Z so it is re-derivable. Implements pre-registration ds-95c94025: the five validity clauses, the arm-2 traffic-inert premise check at its declared 5% threshold, medians with min-max and no intervals, and the rule that two arms whose per-slot ranges overlap are reported as NO RESULT. Written while the campaign was on slot 4 of 12. Q3 was declared exploratory before any data existed.
